title: Will NWS report a high of 90F or higher near Pine Ridge, SD on 2026-09-10?
resolutionCriteria: Resolves YES if the National Weather Service's official high temperature (forecast office Rapid City SD, gridpoint nearest Pine Ridge at approximately 43.02N -102.56W) for 2026-09-10 is reported as 90 degrees Fahrenheit or higher via api.weather.gov climate/forecast data; NO otherwise.
falsifier: Wrong if the NWS-reported high for that date/gridpoint disagrees with the stated probability's implied side by more than the forecast's own stated error model.
